standard_prerequisites.name: Composition of strongly cartesian morphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives that isomorphisms and compositions of strongly cartesian morphisms are strongly cartesian, used in all three axioms.

standard_prerequisites.name: Representable fibres go up
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the base-changed family x_i x_x y with strongly cartesian projection and computes its image in C.

core_obligations: Check axiom (1): a single isomorphism is strongly cartesian and maps to an isomorphism covering in C.
Check axiom (2): compositions y_{ij} -> x are strongly cartesian by composition, and the base images form a covering of C by the base covering axiom.
Check axiom (3): base-change the family along y -> x; the fibre products exist, their projections are strongly cartesian, and their base images cover p(y).
proof_roadmap: Verify the three covering axioms one by one, each by transferring the strongly cartesian property and the covering property along p.
difficulty_reason: Routine three-axiom verification where each step is a direct application of two standard lemmas.
